dishes.name: Muhlama
dishes.desc: A warm breakfast dish of kolot cheese, butter and cornmeal, eaten with cornbread. Rize's signature dish and one of its most consumed.

dishes.name: Laz boregi
dishes.desc: Layers of thin pastry around a vanilla custard, finished with syrup and in Hopa a touch of black pepper. Hopa, in Artvin, holds the geographical indication.

dishes.name: Black cabbage sarma
dishes.desc: Black cabbage leaves wrapped around rice, onion and dill, sometimes with ground meat. A signature Rize dish eaten in colder months.

dishes.name: Pucuko
dishes.desc: Sun-dried green beans cooked with tomato paste and bulgur, with lemon or vinegar if you like. A registered speciality of Artvin.

dishes.name: Silor
dishes.desc: Thin egg-and-milk dough, rolled, cut and baked, then softened and served with yogurt and melted butter. A pastry-like dish from Artvin.
